source_reconnaissance.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_reconnaissance.source_excerpt: 天同与左辅右弼，或天魁天钺同会，以见齐对星始吉，见单星者，主父母两次婚姻。
source_reconnaissance.implication: The source can explicitly distinguish complete pair vs single-star realization. Pair completeness is therefore context-sensitive and cannot be supplied as a global default.

source_reconnaissance.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_reconnaissance.source_excerpt: 寅申宫紫府，必须见辅佐对星者，然后主白头偕老。
source_reconnaissance.implication: When a pair-complete requirement is intended, the source is capable of stating 对星/必须 explicitly. Generic 辅佐/辅弼 surfaces must not inherit this threshold automatically.

source_reconnaissance.source_title: 《中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下）》
source_reconnaissance.source_excerpt: 卯酉廉破，见辅佐单星主再婚。见昌曲对星，又见桃花诸曜，则主移情别恋。
source_reconnaissance.implication: The same corpus distinguishes 单星 and 对星 for auxiliary/pair groups, supporting a source-local contextual-quantifier research program rather than one universal group quantifier.

research_policy.source_local_quantifier_candidate: Explicit local OR/AND/simultaneous/necessity exists; re-read the exact source span before any blocker removal.
research_policy.named_group_relation_review: Named pair/group shorthand dominates; corpus-review 对星/单星/同度/会照 usage before deciding member realization.
research_policy.open_category_no_universal_rule_candidat: Open/valence/functional category likely has no global closed membership or quantifier; seek explicit local exceptions only.
research_policy.closed_world_negation_gated: Even if group membership is known, absence claims require a closed-world evidence contract.
research_policy.compound_or_dependency_gated: Resolve antecedent/composition first; do not infer group activation from inherited wording.
research_policy.source_recheck_required: Compression or lexical shorthand is not safely classified by current semantics; return to source before any formalization.
